snapshot_label: Live-source snapshot from verified bloom data sources

records.title: Iowa Woodland Wildflowers
records.place: Northern, Central, Southern, and Western Iowa
records.status_detail: Iowa DNR reports dated May 4-5, 2026 list current woodland wildflower activity across all four regions.
records.event: No unified event source on the report page
records.evidence_note: Sample records mention South Riverside Trail, Hartman Reserve, Martin's Access, Redtail Ridge, and species such as phlox, violets, Virginia bluebells, wild geranium, and Solomon's seals.

records.title: Anza-Borrego Area Wildflowers
records.place: Anza-Borrego, Cuyamaca, Palomar, and Volcan Mountain area
records.status_detail: Official park update reports cactus and shrub bloom; community records from May 2026 show active mountain-route bloom reports.
records.peak_window: Desert peak usually March-April; higher routes can persist into May
records.event: No unified event source; official page includes hotline and map
records.evidence_note: BorregoWildflowers.org exposes a 2025-2026 bloom report with dated records such as May 11 Volcan Mountain and May 9 Kwaaymii Point West, plus species notes and iNaturalist links.

records.title: Southern California Wild Flower Hotline
records.status_detail: Theodore Payne Foundation publishes weekly illustrated reports during March-May; latest sampled report is dated May 8, 2026.
records.source_name: Theodore Payne Foundation Wild Flower Hotline
records.event: PDF includes selected native plant and chapter events, not a complete event calendar
records.evidence_note: The latest PDF report includes region-level records, location names, species notes, bloom condition text, photos, and selected event listings.

records.title: Sequim Lavender Trail
records.status_detail: Trail guidance says first purple tint often appears in late June, with full bloom around mid-July and harvest roughly one month later.
records.event: Bloom Season Along the Lavender Trail, July 1-31, 2026; Sequim Lavender Weekend, July 18-20, 2026
records.evidence_note: Farm pages expose addresses, hours, activities, and event calendar records for the 2026 lavender season.

records.title: New Hampshire Fall Foliage
records.status: Official tracker available; fall reports not active yet
records.status_detail: Visit NH provides a foliage tracker, text-only report link, and peak foliage map; report freshness needs fall-season recheck.
records.peak_window: Late September to mid-October by region
records.last_updated: 2026 site verified; fall report pending season
records.event: Fall events require Visit NH events calendar
records.evidence_note: The tracker page exposes Launch Foliage Tracker, a text-only updated foliage reports link, and a peak foliage map link, but current report rows were not visible during off-season validation.

records.title: Holland Tulip Time
records.status_detail: Tulip Time 2026 ran May 1-10, 2026; data remains useful for post-season recap and 2027 subscription capture.
records.event: Parades, Dutch Dance, Tulip Immersion Garden, photo walks, tours, concerts, and daily festival events
records.evidence_note: Events page exposes real 2026 schedule rows and destination pages list tulip locations such as Centennial Park and Tulip Lanes.

records.title: Brooklyn Botanic Garden CherryWatch
records.status_detail: CherryWatch page was last updated May 1, 2026 and shows staged cherry collection guidance.
records.event: Garden events available through BBG calendar
records.evidence_note: CherryWatch exposes status legend, last update, special events, and cultivar/location pages for garden-level entity detail.

records.title: DC Tidal Basin Cherry Blossoms
records.status_detail: NPS recorded 2026 peak bloom on March 26; National Cherry Blossom Festival page lists peak bloom as March 26-April 2, 2026.
records.event: NPS ranger programs and National Cherry Blossom Festival partner events
records.evidence_note: NPS Bloom Watch contains bloom stage history, 2026 peak bloom date, and links to official ranger programs and related pages.
